Arcus I, II, III.name: Arcus I-II-III
Arcus I, II, III.summary: Arcus I-II-III (アークス I・II・III) is a first-person dungeon RPG released exclusively for the Sega Mega-CD Japan. It combines the first three games in Wolf Team's Arcus series; Arcus, Arcus II: Silent Symphony and Arcus III, originally released for Japanese computers between 1988 and 1991.

Seima Densetsu 3x3 Eyes.name: 3x3 Eyes Seima Densetsu
Seima Densetsu 3x3 Eyes.summary: Seima Densetsu 3x3 Eyes (聖魔伝説 サザンアイズ) is an RPG for the Sega Mega-CD based upon the 3×3 Eyes anime and manga. It was only released in Japan.
